t: A square touchscreen computer with a camera, microphones and many sensors built in.
steps: Buy the full CoreS3 kit from the M5Stack Store for about 55 US dollars, or from DigiKey in the US. The SE version costs about 35 US dollars but drops the camera and battery.
Plug it into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open the UiFlow2 web editor from M5Stack and connect the CoreS3.
Drag a block that shows a label on the screen and run it.
Add a camera block and show the live picture on the screen.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the M5Unified library for text-based coding.
Use M5GFX version 0.2.27 or newer. Newer units have a screen chip that older versions cannot drive.
Upload an M5Unified example that reads the motion sensor.
meta: Open Board. From $35.40. A few stores.
